parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: The number of items to skip. Useful for pagination (page number * limit)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to fetch

parameters.name: Encoded-Data-Message
parameters.description: The data that was signed by the user for signature recovery

parameters.name: Encoded-Data-Signature
parameters.description: The signature of data, used for signature recovery

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filters the type of transactions to show

parameters.name: include_system_transactions
parameters.description: Include intermediate system transactions in the results

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: Filters the method (sent/received) of transactions to show
